evidence.title: Triplet2Track: A Hierarchical System with Object-Centric Representations for Reliable Long-Horizon Manipulation

summary: Triplet2Track is a hierarchical AI system leveraging object-centric representations to improve reliability in complex, long-duration robotic tasks. The approach aims to enhance autonomous manipulation in dynamic environments.
title: Researchers Introduce Triplet2Track: A New AI System for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
